# FEATURE // IDEA

> **A feature is not only a new capability. It changes a relationship somewhere in the system.**

## What are you proposing?

Describe the idea in the clearest, shortest way you can.

It can be a feature, experiment, workflow, interface change, integration, behavior change, new tool, or a different way of organizing something that already exists.

## What relationship are you trying to create, strengthen, simplify, or change?

Describe the relationship this idea affects.

That might be between a person and a tool, one tool and another, a project and its history, a machine and another machine, an application and its environment, information and the person using it, or something else.

## What is the current relationship?

How does that relationship work today?

If there is no current version, say that.

## What would be better about the proposed relationship?

Explain what becomes easier, clearer, more powerful, more legible, more continuous, more expressive, safer, or more useful.

## What should remain intact?

If this idea changes something that already exists, what continuity, provenance, behavior, identity, or spirit should survive the change?

## What tradeoffs do you expect?

What might become harder, more complex, less compatible, more expensive to maintain, or simply different?

It is fine if you do not know yet.

## Evidence, examples, or references

Screenshots, sketches, recordings, links, examples, comparisons, prior experiments, or anything else that helps explain the idea are welcome.

## Anything else?

Add any context that changes how the idea should be understood.
